business_summary: Eltes Co.,Ltd. engages in the AI security, digital risk, DX promotion, and smart city businesses in Japan. The company offers risk management in the digital space, such as social networking sites, and an internal risk area; web risk monitoring service; and internal threat detection service. It also provides AI security services, which includes AIK order which matches security companies with security clients on the platform; and AIK assign, a SaaS service that digitizes security control operations by arranging and managing the placement of security guards. In addition, the company offers local government DX that supports the digitalization of government services; business company DX which provides support through a hybrid of SES and lab-type development; DX-Pand, an application that consolidates and centralizes various information sent by the government to residents and notifications from existing apps and web services; and Smart Public Lab for GovTech Program. Further, it provides smart city solutions comprising property management DX; digital marketing support; and Miseshirube, a map search-specific customer attraction tool that utilizes Google Business Profiles. Additionally, the company offers digital security solutions, such as SNS risk training, consulting services for emergency situations, search engine reputation management, internal fraud hotline, and internal fraud assessment services. Eltes Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
